#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
umask 077
export GENOS_DISPLAY_DEV="${GENOS_DEV_ROOT:-${GENOS_DEV:-$HOME/DEV}}"
task_logs="$GENOS_DISPLAY_DEV/TRANSFER/rag-progress-graph-r3/bootstrap-logs"
if ! mkdir -p -- "$task_logs"; then task_logs="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/8-agent-display-r3-$(id -u)"; mkdir -p -- "$task_logs"; fi
task_log="$task_logs/$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)-$$.log"
if [[ "${GENOS_DISPLAY_CHILD:-0}" != 1 ]]; then
    export GENOS_DISPLAY_BOOTSTRAP_LOG="$task_log"
    exec > >(tee -a "$task_log") 2>&1
else
    task_log="$GENOS_DISPLAY_BOOTSTRAP_LOG"
fi
trap 'task_exit=$?; printf "DISPLAY_R3_EXIT=%s BOOTSTRAP_LOG=%s\n" "$task_exit" "$task_log"' EXIT
printf 'DISPLAY_R3_BOOTSTRAP_LOG=%s\n' "$task_log"
if [[ -n "${GENOS_PYTHON_DIR:-}" ]]; then export PATH="$GENOS_PYTHON_DIR:$PATH"; elif [[ -x /venv/bin/python3 ]]; then export PATH="/venv/bin:$PATH"; fi
if [[ $# -eq 0 ]]; then set -- apply; fi
python3 - "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" "$@" <<'RAG_DISPLAY_PY'
import base64,hashlib,json,os,sys,types,zlib
from pathlib import Path
_raw=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(''))
assert hashlib.sha256(_raw).hexdigest()=='6b845e2b230405f3ab1364601a08a827630cd2f6642e12f1d269ffc0f12f1bfb'
_mod=types.ModuleType('genos_diagnostics')
_mod.__file__=str(Path.cwd()/'genos_diagnostics.py')
sys.modules['genos_diagnostics']=_mod
exec(compile(_raw,_mod.__file__,'exec'),_mod.__dict__)
_raw=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(''))
assert hashlib.sha256(_raw).hexdigest()=='593e238042797cacea8717b89032fd6c5be6abeb4952343b22aa80480cfcbac3'
_mod=types.ModuleType('genos_log_runner')
_mod.__file__=str(Path.cwd()/'genos_log_runner.py')
sys.modules['genos_log_runner']=_mod
exec(compile(_raw,_mod.__file__,'exec'),_mod.__dict__)
raw=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(''))
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()=='f4276030f3be139f0f992dbfa6e756da90b942ba8f31fbec8f5411041185c8ff'
bundle=json.loads(raw);module=types.ModuleType('r3_display_installer')
exec(compile(base64.b64decode(bundle['code']),'apply_display.py','exec'),module.__dict__)
if os.environ.get('GENOS_DISPLAY_CHILD')=='1':
 raise SystemExit(module.main(bundle['spec'],['--root',os.environ['GENOS_DISPLAY_DEV'],*sys.argv[2:]]))
os.environ['GENOS_DISPLAY_CHILD']='1'
os.environ.setdefault('GENOS_SYSTEM_LOG_DIR','/nfs-root/diamo/8-agent/logs/system')
os.environ.setdefault('GENOS_LOG_RUN_ID','display-r3-'+sys.modules['genos_diagnostics'].uuid.uuid4().hex[:16])
raise SystemExit(sys.modules['genos_log_runner'].main(['--phase','display-r3-deploy','--','bash',sys.argv[1],*sys.argv[2:]]))
RAG_DISPLAY_PY
